commands.petting.summon.error.not_a_mob: Target entity is not a mob and cannot be tamed as a pet.
petting.configuration.title: Petting Configuration
petting.configuration.wiki_link: Need help? Visit the configuration guide on our wiki
petting.configuration.taming.maxHealthPe: The maximum health percentage a mob must be at or below to be tamed (0.0 to 100.0).
petting.configuration.taming.hostileMobs: If enabled, only hostile mobs must be weakened to the health threshold to be tamed. If disabled, all mobs must be weakened.
petting.configuration.taming.unsuccessfu: The percentage chance (0.0 to 100.0) that a taming attempt fails and consumes the treat.
petting.configuration.taming.untameableE: List of entity registry IDs (e.g. 'minecraft:warden' or 'modid:boss_name') that can never be tamed.
petting.configuration.taming.maxPetCount: The maximum number of pets a player can own at a time. Set to -1 for unlimited pets.
petting.configuration.friendlyFire.owner: When enabled, players can attack and damage their own pets. When disabled, pets are immune to damage from their owner.
petting.configuration.friendlyFire.petsC: When enabled, pets belonging to the same owner can attack and damage each other. When disabled, friendly fire between pets of the same owner is prevented.
petting.configuration.behavior.disableBu: When enabled, pets will not naturally attack mobs based on their mob type (e.g. Iron Golems attacking monsters, Wolves hunting sheep, or Withers attacking all living entities). Pets will strictly attack according to their collar tactical settings.
petting.configuration.behavior.enableCol: When enabled, a collar slot is available in all pet inventory GUIs. When disabled, the collar slot is removed from pet inventory GUIs.
petting.configuration.behavior.enablePet: When enabled, players can command owned pets to sit or follow using the configured keybind.
petting.configuration.behavior.forgiveAt: When enabled, commanding a pet to sit clears its attack targets and calms active hostilities, immediately halting combat.
petting.configuration.behavior.flyingPet: When enabled, flying pets commanded to sit will hover stationary in mid-air instead of falling to the ground.
petting.configuration.behavior.swimmingP: Swimming Pets Stay Still When Sitting
When enabled, aquatic pets commanded to sit will remain stationary in water without floating up, sinking, or drifting.
petting.configuration.collar.defaultComb: The default combat mode assigned to new collars and newly tamed pets.
petting.configuration.collar.defaultFoll: The default distance in blocks before a pet starts pathfinding toward its owner.
petting.configuration.collar.minFollowDi: The minimum follow distance selectable on collar sliders in the pet inventory GUI.
petting.configuration.collar.maxFollowDi: The maximum follow distance selectable on collar sliders in the pet inventory GUI.
petting.configuration.collar.defaultTele: The default distance in blocks before a following pet teleports to its owner.
petting.configuration.collar.minTeleport: The minimum teleport distance selectable on collar sliders in the pet inventory GUI.
petting.configuration.collar.maxTeleport: The maximum teleport distance selectable on collar sliders in the pet inventory GUI.
petting.configuration.collar.defaultTele: Whether teleporting to the owner is enabled by default on new collars.
petting.configuration.collar.defaultPref: Whether pets equipped with a collar prefer ranged attacks first when holding a bow or crossbow by default.
petting.configuration.collar.defaultDefe: Whether pets defend fellow pets of the same owner by default.
petting.configuration.collar.defaultReta: Whether pets fight back when damaged by default.
petting.configuration.feedback.enablePos: Whether to display positive feedback messages in chat.
petting.configuration.feedback.enableNeg: Whether to display negative feedback and warning messages in chat.
petting.action.already_tamed_other: This mob already belongs to someone else.
petting.action.already_vanilla_tamed: This mob has already bonded with someone through vanilla taming.
petting.action.too_healthy: This mob is too healthy to tame! Weaken it below %d%% health first.
petting.action.pet_limit_reached: You have reached your pet limit (%s)!
petting.configuration.riding.enablePetRi: When enabled, allowed pets can be ridden and show the Riding button in the pet inventory UI.
petting.configuration.riding.useWhitelis: When enabled, only entity types explicitly listed in the whitelist can be ridden.
petting.configuration.riding.whitelist.t: List of entity registry IDs (e.g. 'minecraft:creeper') that can be ridden when whitelist mode is enabled.
petting.configuration.riding.blacklist.t: List of entity registry IDs (e.g. 'minecraft:bat') that cannot be ridden when whitelist mode is disabled.
petting.gui.collar.mode.passive.title: Passive Mode
petting.gui.collar.mode.passive.desc: Pet never initiates combat or attacks.
petting.gui.collar.mode.passive.inactive: (Retaliation and pet defense are inactive while Passive)
petting.gui.collar.mode.defensive.title: Defensive Mode
petting.gui.collar.mode.defensive.desc: Defends you when attacked. Never initiates combat.
petting.gui.collar.mode.aggressive.title: Aggressive Mode
petting.gui.collar.mode.aggressive.desc: Attacks what you strike and defends you when attacked.
petting.gui.collar.mode.wander.title: Wander Mode
petting.gui.collar.mode.wander.desc: Stays in this area and wanders freely within wander radius without following you away.
petting.gui.collar.mode.guard.title: Guard Mode
petting.gui.collar.mode.guard.desc: Patrols this area and actively hunts untamed hostile monsters within patrol radius.
petting.gui.collar.follow_distance.toolt: Distance in blocks before pet starts following you.
petting.gui.collar.wander_radius.tooltip: Maximum distance in blocks pet will wander from its stationed post.
petting.gui.collar.guard_radius.tooltip: Maximum distance in blocks pet will patrol and engage hostile monsters from its stationed post.
petting.gui.collar.teleport_distance.too: Distance in blocks before pet teleports directly to you.
petting.gui.collar.teleport.on.tooltip: Teleport Enabled: Pet teleports to you if farther than %s blocks.
petting.gui.collar.teleport.off.tooltip: Teleport Disabled: Pet will never teleport; it only follows on foot.
petting.gui.collar.ranged.on.tooltip: Ranged Enabled: When holding a bow, pet keeps distance and shoots arrows.
petting.gui.collar.ranged.off.tooltip: Ranged Disabled: Pet always attacks in melee regardless of held weapon.
petting.gui.collar.defend_pets.on.toolti: Defend Enabled: Pet protects and fights for your other pets when attacked.
petting.gui.collar.defend_pets.off.toolt: Defend Disabled: Pet ignores attacks dealt to your other pets.
petting.gui.collar.retaliate.on.tooltip: Retaliate Enabled: Pet immediately fights back when damaged.
petting.gui.collar.retaliate.off.tooltip: Retaliate Disabled: Pet does not retaliate when taking damage.
petting.gui.collar.reset.tooltip: Reset all settings on this collar to server configuration defaults.
petting.action.mount_uncontrolled: Mounted %s without a saddle. You cannot steer it.
petting.action.saddle_required: This pet requires an equipped saddle to be ridden!
petting.gui.riding.attack_on_click.toolt: Attack on Click: Pressing your Attack key while riding commands your pet to attack or launch projectiles in your aim direction.
petting.gui.riding.auto_attack.tooltip: Auto-Attack Hostiles: When enabled, your ridden pet automatically targets and attacks nearby hostile monsters.
petting.configuration.riding.allowRiding: When enabled, players can mount pets without a saddle, but the pet cannot be steered.
petting.configuration.riding.riddenPetsA: When enabled, pressing your attack key while riding makes the pet execute an attack.
petting.configuration.riding.flyingPetAs: Vertical speed when holding jump on a flying pet.
petting.configuration.riding.flyingPetDe: Vertical speed when holding sneak on a flying pet.
petting.configuration.riding.flyingPetSp: Horizontal speed multiplier for flying pets.
petting.configuration.riding.swimmingPet: Swimming speed multiplier for aquatic pets.
petting.configuration.riding.riddenAttac: Minimum ticks between attacks performed by ridden pets (20 ticks = 1 second).
